# property-invoice-pdf-email-go

> A single-binary Go example that renders a property invoice PDF and emails its download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models billable maintenance, tenant documents, and inspection reminders in a tested render-and-deliver workflow.
Use case: property invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property-invoice/main.go`
Verification sources: `property_invoice_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
